description: We are urgently seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This is an exceptional opportunity for a compassionate leader to make a significant impact on patient care and staff development. As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of care, and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff. We are looking for a proactive individual who can drive clinical excellence and maintain regulatory compliance. This role offers a competitive annual salary of $85,000 - $95,000, reflecting your expertise and commitment.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing
Prior experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills
Knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.
